title: Center for nursing fee.
bodyText:
(a) Upon the issuance of a new license and at each license renewal period, each nurse shall pay an additional fee of $60, which shall be deposited in a separate account in the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o).

[(b)] The director of commerce and consumer affairs shall disburse on a quarterly basis from the compliance resolution fund, established pursuant to section 26-9(o), to the credit of the center for nursing special fund all moneys deposited in the separate account established pursuant to [this section].
crossReferences: Center for nursing special fund, see §304A-2163.

§457-9.5  Center for nursing fee.  (a)  Upon the issuance of a new license and at each license renewal period, each nurse shall pay an additional fee of $60, which shall be deposited in a separate account in the compliance resolution fund established pursuant to section 26-9(o).

     [(b)]  The director of commerce and consumer affairs shall disburse on a quarterly basis from the compliance resolution fund, established pursuant to section 26-9(o), to the credit of the center for nursing special fund all moneys deposited in the separate account established pursuant to [this section]. [L 2003, c 198, §§3, 6, 10; am L 2008, c 173, §2; am L 2012, c 53, §1; am L 2022, c 66, §2]

 

Revision Note

 

  L 2003, c 198, §6 is codified to this section pursuant to §23G-15.
